tagline: An open-source, high-performance AI agent application based on Python
escape_interrupt_hint: Press Esc again to interrupt the conversation
help_lang: Show or change the interface language
help_clear: Clear the screen and reset the current session
help_reset: Reset the current session without clearing the screen
help_session: Show sessions for the current directory
help_session_list: Show sessions for the current directory
help_session_new: Create and switch sessions; when no name is supplied, the LLM names it after the first conversation
help_input: Press Enter to submit and Shift+Enter for a new line (Esc+Enter is also supported).
help_history: Use the Up and Down arrow keys to browse.
language_invalid: Unsupported language: {language}. Enter /lang to list supported languages
no_sessions: There are no sessions in the current directory
file_permission_request: [Permission request] The LLM wants to {action} file: {path}
output_truncated: ... Output was too long; truncated {count} characters
agent_api_no_choices: Agent API error: the streaming response contained no valid choices
session_select_prompt: Select a session (number or name; press Enter to cancel):
session_json_object_required: Session content must be a JSON object
session_number_positive: The session number must be a positive integer
session_number_out_of_range: Session number is out of range: {target}
session_selection_type: A session can only be selected by name or number
session_name_string: The session name must be a string
session_name_empty: The session name cannot be empty
workspace_invalid: The working directory does not exist or is not a directory: {path}
model_api_invalid_json: The model API returned invalid JSON
model_api_missing_message: The model API response is missing choices[0].message: {data}
model_api_invalid_sse: The model API returned invalid SSE JSON: {data}
model_api_returned_error: The model API returned an error: {error}
help_model: View or change the model and reasoning effort for the current session
model_usage:
Usage: /model <model> [effort], or /model effort <effort>
Effort: default, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, max. Availability depends on the model and API. Settings are saved with the current session; chat history is preserved.
/model list — List models available from the current API
model_name_invalid: Model name must be nonempty and contain no whitespace.
help_model_list: List models available from the current API
model_list_empty: The API returned no available models.
